mapper.select: SELECT bin.*, btn.node_name FROM bpm_inst_node bin LEFT JOIN bpm_temp_node btn ON bin.temp_node_id = btn.id WHERE bin.inst_process_id = #{instProcessId}

SELECT bin.*, bdi.module_id, bdi.data_id, bdi.data_name, bdi.process_name AS inst_process_name FROM bpm_inst_node bin LEFT JOIN bpm_data_inst_rel bdi ON bdi.inst_process_id = bin.inst_process_id WHERE bin.id = #{instNodeId}
